request.query: Strict power count inequality for integer coefficient boxes in Siegel lemma Roth theorem

items.name: Int.Matrix.exists_ne_zero_int_vec_norm_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (A : Matrix α β ℤ),
  Fintype.card α < Fintype.card β →
    0 < Fintype.card α →
      ∃ t,
        t ≠ 0 ∧
          A.mulVec t = 0 ∧
            ‖t‖ ≤ (↑(Fintype.card β) * max 1 ‖A‖) ^ (↑(Fintype.card α) / (↑(Fintype.card β) - ↑(Fintype.card α)))

items.name: Int.Matrix.exists_ne_zero_int_vec_norm_le'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (A : Matrix α β ℤ),
  Fintype.card α < Fintype.card β →
    0 < Fintype.card α →
      A ≠ 0 →
        ∃ t,
          t ≠ 0 ∧
            A.mulVec t = 0 ∧
              ‖t‖ ≤ (↑(Fintype.card β) * ‖A‖) ^ (↑(Fintype.card α) / (↑(Fintype.card β) - ↑(Fintype.card α)))

items.name: Int.zpow_pred_clog_lt_self
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ} {r : R}, 1 < b → 0 < r → ↑b ^ (Int.clog b r - 1) < r

items.name: ZLattice.abs_repr_lt_of_norm_lt
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  {L : Submodule ℤ E} [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] {ι : Type u_3} (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (x : ↥L) (n : ℕ),
  ‖x‖ < ZLattice.normBound b * ↑n → ∀ (i : ι), |(b.repr x) i| < ↑n
